description: Q-A0/Q-A1 answer outcome contract — accepted candidate vs transport ok (F02/F03)

invariants: result must equal accepted, never raw after successful repair gate
chat/preview/verification bind the same accepted digest
sync call ok=false; outcome=failed is the product truth

outcome is independent of HTTP/transport success
accepted candidate is the only text attached as success result
gateway treats mode=gated_error or outcome!=succeeded as not live_ok
